weather.model: ERA5 (single reanalysis; no best-match model mixing)
weather.index_def: Saisonaler Wasserbilanz-Index Z_JJA = ((P-ET0)_Jun-Aug - mu_JJA(1991-2020))/sigma_JJA(1991-2020); <0 = Defizit. Bewusst KEIN SPEI (keine log-logistic-Wahrscheinlichkeitstransformation).
weather.grain_note: annual = raw summer values (n=10 consecutive summers, exploratory - inter-annual autocorrelation not modeled); monthly = within-month anomalies -> p_block from a year-block permutation test (blocks exchangeable whole summers; Student-t p assumes independence and is optimistic here)
